top_signals.title: Stocks Extend Drop as Risk-Off Dominates With Oil Up, Meta Down
top_signals.summary: Stocks extended declines in Thursday afternoon trading as escalating concern about Mideast conflict pushed oil futures higher, spurring inflation fears with US midterm elections less than two weeks away. Meta Platforms Inc. tumbled as investors parsed its results along with the rest of the latest batch of technology earnings for evidence that massive spending on AI is paying off.
